title: Cross-Fitted Clipped Covariance Estimation with a Data-Driven Tail-Energy Criterion
abstract: arXiv:2602.14020v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Heavy-tailed data make covariance estimation sensitive to the clipping level: stronger clipping reduces variance but increases bias. We study how to choose this clipping level from the data within a radial clipped covariance family. We propose the quantile tail-energy surrogate (QTES), a fully data-driven rule that combines a cross-fitted variance certificate with a held-out estimate of the tail energy removed by clipping. QTES requires no distributional prior parameters. For Euclidean clipping, the operator-norm bias is bounded by this scalar tail-energy quantity. Under a finite $L_4$ moment condition, together with a mild feasibility condition for the QTES block construction, we prove a uniform finite-sample calibration bound over a positive clipping grid and a finite-sample guarantee for the estimator selected by QTES, relative to the best candidate on that grid under the same variance-plus-bias criterion. translated_title: 基于数据驱动尾部能量准则的交叉拟合截断协方差估计
translated_abstract: 重尾数据使得协方差估计对截断水平非常敏感：更强的截断会降低方差但会增加偏差。我们研究如何在径向截断协方差族中从数据出发选择这一截断水平。我们提出了分位数尾部能量替代准则（QTES），这是一种完全数据驱动的规则，它将交叉拟合的方差证书与对截断所去除尾部能量的保留样本估计相结合。QTES不需要任何分布先验参数。对于欧几里得截断，算子范数偏差被这一标量尾部能量量所界定。在有限 $L_4$ 矩条件以及QTES块构造的温和可行性条件下，我们证明了正截断网格上的一致有限样本校准界，以及QTES所选择的估计器相对于同一方差加偏差准则下该网格上最优候选者的有限样本保证。实验在……
tldr: 该论文提出了完全数据驱动的分位数尾部能量替代准则（QTES），通过结合交叉拟合方差证书与截断所去除尾部能量的保留估计来自动选择最优截断水平，无需分布先验参数，并在有限样本下提供相对于最优候选估计器的理论保证。
